case.question: Do these two blocks disagree? Answer tension when they cannot both hold, else no_tension. A tension names, for each block that takes part, what in it disagrees.

schema.findings: a list of {block, note}: block is one of the two block ids; note is 1 to 2000 characters; a tension verdict needs 1 to 20 findings, a no_tension verdict 0 to 20
schema.reason: with severity blocking only: why the tension should block, 1 to 2000 characters
schema.severity: advisory (default) or blocking, on a tension verdict only: blocking advises a person to make the tension block; it gates nothing until a person accepts it
